index.title: Automate Content Analysis
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Content Analysis. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Automate Content Analysis. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a different job
index.what_happened_excerpt: A user connected their online accounts to a bot, which analyzed performance data and generated draft content. This published job follows the public pattern to automate content analysis and generation.
